How it works

Calculate a new salary and annual increase from a percentage raise. Use the units shown in the calculator and review every assumption before using the result.

Formula

New salary = current salary × (1 + raise percentage).

Worked example

A 5% raise on $60,000 increases annual pay by $3,000 to $63,000.

Important assumptions

This tool is designed for planning and comparison. Real-world prices, manufacturer ratings, building requirements, lender terms, electrical codes, tolerances, and product specifications can vary.
